architecture: SHARED_EQUITY_PLUS_LEAGUE_CALIBRATION: one shared ridge model on raw (projected_win_probability, team_score_v2_calibrated, team_count) -> oracle_win_probability directly, plus a light per-team_count linear recalibration. Validated via leave-one-season-out AND leave-one-team-count-out transport (see run_championship_equity_v2_model_ladder_v1.py output / NWR_CHAMPIONSHIP_EQUITY_V2_MULTI_LEAGUE_REPORT).
note: Team Score V2's contribution to this model is DECISIVE FOR CALIBRATION (MAE reduced ~2x-5x vs. championship_equity() alone at every team_count) but NOT clearly decisive for RANKING (Spearman roughly ties the baseline alone) -- both findings reported honestly, not just the favorable one.
